description: This file defines the 'Affiliate' controller class within the OpenCart admin system. It handles email notifications for affiliate approval and denial, loading models, language files, and creating email tasks with specified content.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Controller class handling affiliate email notifications for approval and denial within the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Handles the process of sending an approval email to an affiliate after their account is approved.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Handles the process of sending a denial email to an affiliate when their account is denied.
